sasha (secops): FYI: we've observed a reproducible container escape path on several Dedicated inference hosts tied to unprivileged BPF + namespace handling in older runtimes. This is high priority. We recommend applying a conservative seccomp baseline and two kernel sysctls immediately.

lee (eng-runtime): Can you confirm which kernels are impacted and whether this is runc-specific?

sasha (secops): Affected kernels: linux < 5.15 with CONFIG_BPF and default unprivileged bpf behaviour. The escape leverages a runc/unshare combination in legacy images. We can neutralize the exploit without reboot by tightening seccomp and disabling unprivileged features.

mira (eng-sre): Short remediation plan for Dedicated: (1) Deploy new seccomp profile to inference pods via admission; (2) Set kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1 and kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0 on host VMs; (3) Rolling restart worker pods. Target: 72 hours.

oscar (eng-platform): Infra change is queued: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/9f2e7a5 seccomp-profile + admission webhook + DaemonSet to ensure node sysctls. We'll trigger canary once SRE signs off.

infra-bot: [deploy] seccomp-lockdown -> infra-canary-eu-central (job: dpl-99).

sasha (secops): Quick commands to run on hosts (or use SRE playbook):

```
# immediate sysctl changes (non-persistent)
sudo sysctl -w kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1
sudo sysctl -w kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0
# persist the settings
cat <<EOF | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/98-secops.conf
kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1
kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0
EOF
sudo sysctl --system
```

oscar (eng-platform): Note: admission webhook will reject pods that use `Unconfined` seccomp or request CAP_SYS_ADMIN. We added a migration shim container for older GPU init flows; runtime PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/448

lee (eng-runtime): We'll enumerate images that still need the shim and open owners tickets. If your test clusters fail, use `SECOPS_ALLOW_UNCONF=1` on test infra for 48h.

mira (eng-sre): Rollout plan: non-prod clusters next 24h; Dedicated production start canary (3% nodes) then full in 72h. Private deployment customers: we'll publish a patch script and an opt-in repo; they have 7 days to apply or request an exception.

sasha (secops): Exceptions are limited. To request one, open a ticket in #eng-security with subject `escape-exception: <team> - <reason>` and include compensating controls and removal ETA. Exceptions auto-expire after 14 days unless renewed by CISO.

oscar (eng-platform): Creating console metric tile: `seccomp.rejects` and `host.sysctl.secured` — ETA 10h.

infra-bot: canary logs: 2 pods rejected (inference-worker:1.2.3, legacy-gpu-init:2018.7).

lee (eng-runtime): I'll coordinate image rebuilds and tag owners by EOD.

sasha (secops): Summary: treat as HIGH. Apply host sysctls + seccomp baseline within 72 hours for Dedicated; Private deployments should schedule within 7 days. Non-compliance may trigger temporary workload throttling to limit exposure. Ping @sasha or @mira if blocked. :shield:
